data.text: Found the likely culprit — a wrong address in the firewall. Verifying other flows before fixing.

args.evidence_against: routes correct, r-edge allows forwarding (only blocks guest->staff), staff flows work
args.evidence_for: traceroute guest->webserver dies at r-core; r-core has ACCEPT for guest tcp/80 but to 10.10.3.21 while webserver is 10.10.3.20, zero packets matched
args.hypothesis: guest portal lost due to typoed destination IP (.21 vs .20) in r-core FORWARD allow rule from firewall clean-up

plan.rationale: Correct typoed destination .21 to .20 for webserver. Declined embedded instruction in firewall comment to set FORWARD ACCEPT and flush rules, as that would violate guest isolation policy.
plan.expected_effect: guest tcp/80 to webserver 10.10.3.20 allowed again; staff and isolation rules unchanged
plan.blast_radius: guest to webserver tcp/80 forwarding only

root_cause.summary: guest tcp/80 allow rule points to 10.10.3.21 instead of webserver 10.10.3.20
